description: a sealed jar of pickled vegetables from 1891. the seal is intact — technically still preserved and edible. they smell strongly of vinegar and herbs.
name: pickled_vegetables

params.message: You crack the seal and eat a forkful of the pickles. The vinegar and herbs hit the back of your throat like a slap, and your mouth waters.

item.fail_message: The jar is empty but for brine.
